name: Dingle in a day
description_md:
Dingle in a day is a waymarked hiking route located in IE. The path covers a distance of 14.2 km and requires about 6.8 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This route is classified as a waymarked hiking route. It is situated within IE.
